instruction: Based on the recommended extensions in the Desktop document, install all of them to your Chrome browser.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all 5 Chrome extensions based on the document recommendations. Evaluator verifies installation by checking Chrome's extension settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts all installed extension names from extensions.settings[id].manifest.name
Metric comparison logic is correct: uses set subset check to verify all expected extensions are installed
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all 5 required extensions from the instruction
Expected values are semantically correct: the 5 extension names match actual Chrome Web Store extension names
Practical feasibility: getter reads from file system (not UI), so no postconfig needed despite static warning
The subset check appropriately allows additional extensions beyond the required 5
